title: Demographic Inference from Social Media Data with Multimodal Foundation Models: Strategies, Evaluation, and Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating inference accuracy, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and F1 scores across different age cohorts (18–24, 25–34, 35–44, 45–54, 55–64, 65+) to measure performance disparities and misclassification patterns.
Evaluating inference accuracy and F1 scores across gender groups (Male, Female) using confusion matrices to measure performance disparities.

Evaluating inference accuracy and F1 scores across racial and ethnic groups (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, Other) using confusion matrices to identify performance disparities and cross-group confusion.
